input: RSVP to Marcus and Leila's housewarming party

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the RSVP is just a yes/no confirmation or also involves communicating additional details like number of guests, dietary needs, or a gift
Whether you are RSVPing for yourself only or on behalf of multiple people (e.g. a plus-one, family), which changes what you need to communicate
Whether there is a deadline by which the RSVP must be sent, which affects urgency and prioritisation
The channel to use — text, phone call, email, a formal RSVP link — determines the actual next action
Whether you are attending, declining, or still undecided changes the entire content of the message
The tone and length of the message — a quick text vs. a warm personal note — depends on the closeness of the relationship and personal style
Whether 'done' means only sending the RSVP or also includes follow-up actions like arranging a gift or organising transport
